newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at mostly steady levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at mostly steady levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted in bids and offers mostly steady on Wednesday the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Tuesday.
- One barge, Fiber Lift, Grain or Product, Cincinnati, Ohio River, on station, no bid, offered 100 percent of tariff, unchanged from Tuesday.
- One barge, Fiber Lift, Memphis, Mississippi River, $500 switched, this week, no bid, offer 90 percent, unchanged from Tuesday.
- 18 barges, mid-Mississippi River, two each weeks of June and July, bid 110 percent of tariff, similar unchanged from Tuesday, offer 120 percent, unchanged from May 20.
- Eight barges, McGregor and South, Mid-Mississippi, two each week of September, bid 165 percent, unchanged from Tuesday, similar, no offer.
